items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Hamp was still with him, and let's see, Ziggy Elman (PHONETIC) was with him, Harry James, and -- I'm trying to think of the tenor players. That was the old Benny Goodman band.

ctx.x: Let's see, the trumpet player, he (Goodman) was Irving. / Yeah, and then the other brother was playing bass. In fact, Teddy Wilson told me that's why the trio was a trio, and not a quartet. Because they really didn't make it on bass.
